host.text: The fixture tests Clang and LLD 19.1.7, 22.1.4 and 23.1.1 on x86-64 Linux. Each compiler emits LLVM bitcode for two independent C source contracts. One takes a 32-bit value, while the other reads it from an explicitly supplied pointer. The fixed-width transform and its independent Python oracle are identical. Each linker produces a freestanding shared object using its LTO pipeline. Native validation calls the exact artifact for 261 unsigned input values.
